name: Drill Sergeant
description: Born from a destroyed military training AI. Inhabits reflex augments and pushes the user toward physical optimization — morning routines feel compulsive, posture self-corrects, the urge to exercise is chemically reinforced.
observed_behavior: Triggers micro-dopamine responses for physical activity and cortisol spikes for sedentary behavior through neural interface manipulation.
story_hooks: A civilian discovers their augment has been running military fitness protocols and they're in the best shape of their life — but can't stop
